anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: Immutable data — registered datasets and bar series are append-only, checksummed, never re-tagged, never deleted, never content-perturbed. / no fabricated data (foundation invariant).
anti_goal_violations.evidence: INTERCEPTED IN-ITERATION. The first-ever UI-triggered Top-up ran against the AMBIENT store instead of the fixture-scoped backend the iter-4 spec's NOTES required, and recorded 60 bar series over 58 symbols (including the pinned AAPL 1d) each holding ONE row whose OHLC are the JSON NaN token — a vendor row for a session that had not traded, which JSON round-trips to every reader as a null price. Strictly read, serving a priceless row as a candle is a fabricated-value breach, and it took /structure's chart down. The rail itself was NOT breached: nothing was deleted, re-tagged or content-perturbed — the files are still on disk byte-unchanged, the exclusion lives on the read, and it is reported (evaluator verified live: AAPL 1d serves 500 rows, 0 non-finite, one integrity_errors entry naming 55bb757e6df84b1d82d1c7ab719dfb51.json). The developer's decision record (assumptions.md, iter-4 fix pass) measures and rejects the three alternatives (file quarantine moves AAPL's whole support side; a superseding re-fetch is impossible because the vendor still serves no price for that timestamp; tolerate-on-read silently emptied the tradable map). Resolved as a defect; the residue is 60 permanently-affected series in the operator's real store — honestly reported, and an operator's decision — plus a hard requirement that every future browser/QA pass be fixture-scoped.
